iti18:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti18:2.1: “One thing, monks, when arising in the world, arises for the detriment of many, for the unhappiness of many, for the detriment & unhappiness of many beings, both human & divine.
iti18:2.4: When the Saṅgha is split, there are arguments with one another, there is abuse of one another, ganging up on one another, abandoning of one another.
iti18:2.5: There those with little confidence [in the teaching] lose all confidence, while some of those who are confident become otherwise.”
iti18:3.3: one who has split the Saṅgha.
iti18:3.4:
Delighting in factions,
unjudicious–
he’s barred
from safety from bondage.
iti18:3.5: Having split a Saṅgha in concord,
iti18:3.6:
he cooks for an eon
in hell.
